model: Developer blended NTA exit-P/B and earnings exit-P/E: attributable earnings capitalised at cost of equity (engine route)

inputs.sbc_source: FY2023-FY2025 annual reports, consolidated cash flow statement: no equity-settled share-based payment charge since the FY2022 credit of RMB-128.8m (FY2022 AR line 7144); FY2023 AR line 6832 shows nil. SBC-zero filer: house and street bases coincide.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and flows are RMB (CNY); the HKEX quote is HKD. fx_rate is CNY->HKD = 1.1721 from Yahoo Finance CNYHKD=X at 2026-10-10 (regularMarketTime 1791603508). All per-share values are computed in RMB and multiplied by fx_rate into HKD; the unsuffixed intrinsic_value / weighted_iv are HKD so they compare to current_price. No liquid dual listing exists for a parity check; the direction was checked against the company's own HK-cent DPS (FY2025 HK50c on RMB attributable EPS 1.16 = payout 37% in RMB terms, consistent with the ~40% payout management describes). Refresh fx_rate whenever the price is refreshed - refresh_price.py does not move it.
inputs.share_count_basis: 10,944,884,000 ordinary shares (FY2025 AR line 8781, share capital unchanged at RMB74,035m in the 30 Jun 2026 interim). No dilutive instruments outstanding; the share option scheme has had no charge since FY2022. Held flat.

reported_balance_sheet_anchors_rmb_m.note: Recorded for audit only. The engine's net_debt/total_debt/cash fields are set to 0 because the capitalised stream (attributable earnings) is already after interest and after NCI; subtracting net debt again would deduct it twice (SKILL.md: never FCF/WACC on a post-interest flow). 30 June 2026 interim, RMB'000 converted to millions.

inputs.wacc_rationale: The 'wacc' field carries the RMB COST OF EQUITY, not a WACC: the stream is attributable earnings, which is after the 2.76% average borrowing cost on RMB237bn of debt. Built in the flows' currency: China 10-year CGB ~1.8% + beta 1.2 x RMB equity risk premium 6.0% (mature 4.5% + China country premium 1.5%) = 9.0%, plus 1.0pp for state-directed capital allocation that a minority holder cannot discipline (RMB118.7bn of land bought in FY2025 into a falling market, dividends cut three years running while land spend rose). Governance risk sits in the rate because it is not scenario-able; cyclicality, margin and asset-value risk sit in the three scenarios and the terminal multiples, so each risk is charged exactly once. 10.0% in every scenario.
inputs.lease_treatment: (A) Leases as debt - but immaterial: lease liabilities RMB281m against RMB237bn of borrowings. Lease interest is already inside the pre-tax profit stream; no lease charge in the flows, and nothing in the (zero) bridge. Consistent with the parser's total_debt definition which excludes lease liabilities.
inputs.nci_treatment: Charged once, in the flows: cash_tax_rate_path is a combined leakage rate (PRC income tax + land appreciation tax ~35% of pre-tax profit, then NCI ~12% of post-tax profit; 1-(0.65 x 0.88) = 42.8%). Calibration: FY2025 pre-tax profit RMB20,815m x (1-0.39) = RMB12,691m attributable (CSV OperatingIncome is profit before tax; attributable NI 12,691; leakage 39.0%). H1 FY2026: 12,547 pre-tax -> 7,030 attributable, leakage 44.0% as NCI share rose to 12.2% (NCI equity RMB33.9bn vs RMB21.2bn at FY2024). Forward 43% base. No NCI deduction in the bridge.
inputs.notes: MODEL: Developer blended NTA exit-P/B and earnings exit-P/E (dcf-methods SKILL.md routing row 'Land subdivider, inventory-heavy developer'), run through the Drivers engine with net debt at zero. Why not owner-FCF: reported FCF swings from RMB-17.9bn (FY2022) to +42.2bn (FY2024) to +11.1bn (FY2025) on the timing of land premium and pre-sales, a cycle-position signal rather than a value; and EV less RMB116bn net debt plus RMB34bn NCI would deduct financing that the earnings stream already carries. Why not a REIT AFFO model: commercial operations are 4% of revenue. ENGINE MAPPING: base_revenue = FY2025 revenue; 'ebitda_margin_path' = PROFIT BEFORE TAX margin (after net finance cost and share of JVs/associates; FY2025 12.4%, H1 FY2026 12.9%); sbc/lease/D&A/capex paths are 0 and wc_capture is 0 so EBIT = pre-tax profit; 'cash_tax_rate_path' = combined tax + NCI leakage, so NOPAT = profit attributable to shareholders = the flow discounted at the 10% RMB cost of equity. last_fcf is therefore FY2025 attributable NI RMB12,691m, not owner FCF; reported_fcf is kept for the record. TERMINAL = the blend. Exit P/E leg: 8x base / 6x bear / 10x bull (COLI traded 5-8x through 2022-26; 8-12x in 2018-20). Exit P/B leg: 0.50x base / 0.30x bear / 0.70x bull against year-10 attributable book (RMB392.7bn today, growing with ~55% retention of earnings in base and bull, flat in bear as impairments absorb retention), converted to a P/E via exit P/B / year-10 ROE: base ROE ~3.3% -> 15.2x; bull ~4.6% -> 15.1x; bear ~1.4% on 0.30x -> ~20x. 50/50 blend of the two legs: base 11.6x -> terminal_cap_multiple 11.5; bull 12.5x -> 12.5; bear 13x -> 13.0 (in bear Gordon at 10%/0.5% = 10.6x binds instead, so the bear is pure earnings-capitalisation and does not lean on book). The engine applies TV = max(0, min(Gordon, cap x E_N)); which bound is recorded per scenario in the generated JSON. CAVEAT the reader should hold: an earnings stream at cost of equity treats retained earnings as worth par; at a ~3% ROE reinvested in a shrinking market that is generous, and the dividend-only view (HK50c at 10%/1.5%) is ~HK$6/share. The P/B leg in the terminal is where the land bank, the RMB203bn investment-property book and the REIT recycling channel are credited; at the current price the market credits neither (0.32x book, ~11x TTM earnings). SBC-zero: band_position null. Price: HKEX regular close; not an after-hours print.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case terminal growth (RMB nominal). Equity 5yr CAGR of 4.3% rejected as the growth anchor: book grows by retaining ~55% of earnings at a ~3% ROE, not by earnings power, while attributable EPS compounded at -22%/yr FY2020-25. Revenue is -2%/yr over 3 and 5 years.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR +4.3% (5yr) vs EPS CAGR -22.0% and revenue -2.0%: divergence far beyond 30%. Book is accreting while earnings power collapses (gross margin 30.0% FY2020 -> 15.5% FY2025); ROE has fallen from 14% to 3.3%. This is the core of the valuation question and why the model blends an asset leg with an earnings leg.
historical_growth.notes: FCF CAGRs are undefined: reported FCF was negative at both start points (FY2020 RMB-2.5bn, FY2022 RMB-17.9bn) and is dominated by land-premium timing (FY2024 +42.2bn as land spend fell; FY2025 +11.1bn). SBC is nil throughout so there is no SBC-adjusted series to compare. The flow this model capitalises is attributable earnings, whose CAGRs are reported above. Cash taxes paid fell from RMB22.6bn (FY2022) to RMB9.2bn (FY2025) with profit, consistent with the ~35% combined CIT + LAT rate.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 +5%: H1 FY2026 revenue was +17% on handovers but H2 FY2025 (RMB84.9bn) is a high comparator; lands ~RMB176bn. FY2027 -8% and FY2028 -2%: revenue recognises contracted sales 1.5-2 years later and FY2025 Group Series contracted sales fell 19% to RMB251bn (FY2024 RMB310bn); H1 FY2026 sales +11.8% to RMB134bn refills the pipeline from FY2028. Then 2%/yr nominal with national new-home sales still shrinking but COLI taking share from defaulted private developers.
base.margin_rationale: Pre-tax margin 11.5% in FY2026-27 (FY2025 12.4%, H1 FY2026 12.9%, but H2 handovers carry 2021-22 vintage land at 15-16% gross margin). Recovery to 15% by FY2033 as land bought at trough prices in FY2024-26 (73.9% of FY2025 land premium in the five first-tier cities) is delivered at ~20% gross margin; still half the FY2018-20 pre-tax margin of 35-41%.
base.terminal_rationale: Blend: 0.5 x exit P/E 8x + 0.5 x (exit P/B 0.50x / year-10 ROE 3.3% = 15.2x) = 11.6x -> cap 11.5x. Gordon at 10%/1.5% = 11.9x, so the cap binds. Terminal growth 1.5% RMB nominal: urban housing demand shrinking with population, offset by share gains and rent growth on the commercial book.

bull.terminal_rationale: Blend: 0.5 x exit P/E 10x + 0.5 x (exit P/B 0.70x / year-10 ROE 4.6% = 15.1x) = 12.5x. Gordon at 10%/2.5% = 13.7x, cap binds. 0.70x book is roughly where CR Land trades today and where COLI traded in 2021.

bear.terminal_rationale: Blend: 0.5 x exit P/E 6x + 0.5 x (exit P/B 0.30x on a book held flat by impairments / year-10 ROE 1.4% = ~20x) = 13x. Gordon at 10%/0.5% = 10.6x binds, so the bear value rests on earnings alone and gives no credit to book. Leakage 45%: LAT falls with margin but NCI share of a smaller profit pool rises.

scenario_narratives.base: The sector keeps shrinking (national new-home sales -6% in 2026 per S&P) but first-tier cities stabilise first and COLI, the only developer rated A- by two agencies and borrowing at 2.76%, converts its counter-cyclical land buying (RMB118.7bn in FY2025, RMB33.3bn attributable YTD 2026) into share. Revenue dips in FY2027-28 as the 19% fall in FY2025 contracted sales reaches handover, then grows ~2%/yr. Pre-tax margin troughs at 11.5% as 2021-22 land clears, then recovers to 15% as trough-priced tier-1 land completes - never back to the 35-41% of FY2018-20. ROE stays ~3-4%; the stock exits at a blend of 8x earnings and 0.5x book. Dividends roughly track a 40% payout.
scenario_narratives.bull: Policy support (purchase-restriction easing in Beijing/Shanghai, land-supply controls, urban renewal) produces a tier-1 price and volume recovery from 2027; Hong Kong sales hit the record management is targeting; contracted sales growth of the H1 FY2026 kind (+11.8%) persists. Land bought at trough prices in 2024-26 delivers at 20%+ gross margins, lifting pre-tax margin to 17%. Further REIT issuance (after the ~100x oversubscribed China Overseas Commercial REIT) recycles the RMB203bn commercial book at near carrying value, which is what justifies a 0.70x exit P/B. Value ~RMB19-20/share.
scenario_narratives.bear: No bottom: a further leg down in national sales, local-government fiscal stress, and tier-1 ASPs following lower-tier cities. The RMB152bn of land bought in FY2025-26 is delivered into falling prices, pre-tax margin compresses to 8% and inventory impairments absorb all retained earnings so book stops growing. Revenue falls ~25% over five years to RMB130bn and stays there. Interest cover (already 2.8x from 7.2x in FY2021) tightens but the SOE parent keeps refinancing open, so this is an earnings-and-dividend collapse, not a solvency event; the stock is capitalised at 10.6x a RMB5-6bn earnings run-rate with no credit for book.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 30% from the 15% default: the market is in a multi-year structural decline with no confirmed bottom, COLI's own contracted sales fell 19% in FY2025, the dividend has been cut three periods running, and its state-directed land buying into that market is the exact mechanism by which the bear case would be realised. Bull trimmed to 20%: it needs a tier-1 price recovery, margin expansion on new land AND a book-value re-rating via REIT recycling to happen together. Base 50%: survive-and-consolidate at low margins is the central case for the sector's best credit.

valuation_philosophy.summary: COLI is valued as the sector's survivor, not as a growth company: an attributable-earnings stream at a 10% RMB cost of equity, exiting at a blend of a low earnings multiple and a steep discount to book. The two legs disagree sharply - book is RMB35.9/share (HK$42) and the stock trades at 0.32x it, while earnings power has fallen 70% in five years to a ~3% ROE that on its own justifies roughly today's price. The blend credits half the book discount closing over ten years via trough-priced tier-1 land, REIT recycling and share gains, and half of it never closing. Reported FCF and EV-based multiples are not used: FCF is land-timing noise and the earnings stream is already after RMB237bn of 2.76% debt and after NCI.
key_risks_to_valuation: Earnings capitalised at cost of equity treats retained earnings as worth par; with ~55% of earnings reinvested in land at a ~3% ROE, a dividend-only valuation is ~HK$6/share. The gap between that and the base value is the price of believing book value is eventually realisable.

Book quality: RMB442bn of inventory at cost less impairment and RMB203bn of investment property at fair value with 78% office occupancy. A 10% write-down of inventory is RMB4/share of NTA; the 0.50x base exit P/B is the buffer, but the bear exit P/B of 0.30x may still flatter a disorderly market.

Leakage: NCI share of profit rose from 5.5% (FY2025) to 12.2% (H1 FY2026) as NCI equity grew to RMB33.9bn; combined tax + NCI leakage of 43% could run higher if JV-heavy tier-1 projects dominate handovers.

Governance and policy: a 56%-owned CSCEC subsidiary buying land to stabilise the market; dividend cut from HK121c (FY2021) to HK50c (FY2025) while land spend rose. Charged as 1pp in the discount rate, which is a judgment.
Currency: RMB flows, HKD quote. A 5% RMB depreciation against the pegged HKD moves every HKD value by 5%; fx_rate is dated and is not refreshed by refresh_price.py.

Revenue timing: handovers lag contracted sales by 1.5-2 years, so FY2027-28 revenue is largely set by FY2025-26 sales; the base path assumes -8%/-2%, which is a judgment on attributable share of Group Series sales.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of (HKEX regular close); 52-week range 11.36-16.70 HKD. FX from Yahoo CNYHKD=X, dated in inputs.fx_note.
